what: What the starter itself says to a person (permission question, failed run, reminders, notices, the hint on an answer without a card) comes from one table by the agent's language (GET /api/v1/agent lang: de, en, fr, es, it, nl; missing = English), and the check for an answer that asks without a card knows these six languages. Status texts go out with the optional text_key / text_at in PUT /agent/status: the app shows them in the language of whoever looks, text stays the fallback for an older app; an older server (400) gets the status again without the key
